```{r}
schools_distinct <- schools |> 
  distinct_unique_by(c("school_id", "data_schoolyear")) 

schools_distinct <- full_join(
  schools_distinct |> 
    arrange(school_id, data_schoolyear) |> 
    slice(1, .by = school_id),
  
  schools_distinct,
  
  by     = c("school_id"),
  suffix = c(".baseline", "")
)
```


```{r}
head(step_df <- schools_distinct |> 
  select(
    school_id,
    data_schoolyear,
    matches("impl"),
    matches("date"),
    matches("student_count"),
    matches("asthma"),
    matches("attend"),
    matches("days"),
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    sy_days        = as.numeric(difftime(asthma_date, demog_date, units = "days")) + 20,
    impl_frac_days = as.numeric(difftime(asthma_date, impl_date, units = "days")),
    impl_frac_days = unlist(map(impl_frac_days, min, sy_days)),
    impl_frac_days = unlist(map(impl_frac_days, max, 0)),
    impl_sy_frac   = round(impl_frac_days / sy_days, 1)
    ) |> 
  arrange(impl_date, school_id, data_schoolyear) |> 
  mutate(
    impl_cum_frac    = cumsum(impl_sy_frac),
    years_since_impl = floor(impl_cum_frac - 0.01),
    years_since_impl = unlist(map(years_since_impl, max, 0)),
    .by              = school_id
    ))


step_df |> 
  count(data_schoolyear, impl_date, impl_cum_frac, years_since_impl)
```

```{r}
step_df |> filter(is.na(asthma_pct.baseline))
```


```{r}
library(geepack)
summary(asth_geemod <- geeglm(
  I(asthma_pct - asthma_pct.baseline) ~
    factor(data_schoolyear) +
    factor(impl_sy_frac) + 
    years_since_impl +
    asthma_pct.baseline +
    factor(impl_date),
  id     = school_id,
  family = gaussian,
  corstr = "exchangeable",
  data   = step_df
))

summary(asth_geemod)
```


```{r}
emmeans::emmeans(
  asth_geemod, 
  revpairwise ~ impl_date, 
  at = list(impl_date = unique(step_df$impl_date))
  )
```

```{r}
emmeans::emmeans(
  asth_geemod, 
  revpairwise ~ impl_sy_frac, 
  at = list(impl_sy_frac = c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 1))
  )
```
